purpose: Button that writes plain text plus optional rich HTML/image clipboard representations and flips to a confirmation state after success.
useWhen: Offering one-click copy of a token, snippet, share link, or code sample.
Pairing with code-block so readers can grab the rendered source.
Copying a value in running text with the inline appearance.

avoidWhen.reason: Triggering a generic non-clipboard action — use button instead.
Copying long-form rich content that needs format preservation — handle clipboard logic directly.
